Subject: Exec recap + next steps — Redwood POC & procurement path

Hi Ellen / Samir (cc'd Aditya & Neha),

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick executive-level recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

High-level outcomes discussed
- Business outcome: reduce average conversational latency for clinician-facing assistant from ~1.2s to <200ms P95 for patient triage flows, and reduce inference cost per consult by ~40% with batching/caching.
- Risk drivers: PHI handling & auditability, uptime for live triage, and model safety / hallucination mitigation for clinical guidance.

Pain points confirmed
- Current vendor has frequent latency spikes and opaque cost model (hard to predict monthly spend).
- Audit logs and retention for conversations are limited; compliance team flagged SOC2 evidence gaps.
- Need deterministic fallbacks for critical flows (escalation to human operator).

Proposed POC scope (30-45 days)
1) Deploy Redwood in a private/demo VPC mode using a representative triage model (finetuned or open model variant).
2) Run a pilot traffic slice (non-production) against two routes: triage (low-latency) and aftercare (higher context). Evaluate latency, cost, and regression on quality using your existing eval set.
3) Instrument audit logs + retention policy (30/365 day options) and provide sample SOC2 artifacts.
4) Define SLOs: latency P95 <200ms (triage), availability 99.9% for pilot.

Procurement path & ask
- Next step: get procurement contact engaged and agree on a simple SOW + PoC order (we've attached draft SOW and pricing sheet).
- If procurement is comfortable, we can stand up the PoC under a 30-day trial credit + an MSA addendum.

Decisions I need from you this week
- Exec sponsor confirmation (who will own the internal success criteria?).
- Procurement contact + preferred contracting timeline.
- Any regulatory constraints (e.g., specific KMS/HSM vendors, stricter data residency) we should bake into the SOW.

Attachments: AuroraMed_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), redwood-pricing-sheet-2026.xlsx

I recommend a short SOW signature + kickoff next week so we can hit a 30-45 day PoC and present results to Samir and the board. Happy to jump on a quick sync with procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ellen — great, and thanks for looping procurement. Quick answers below and next suggested steps: 

KMS / Key management
- We support both customer-managed KMS (recommended for Prod) and Redwood-managed keys for PoC. For PoC, using Redwood-managed KMS is fine — we can export SOC2 artifacts showing key handling. If AuroraMed prefers HSM integration, we can scope that as part of the SOW.

Minimal commitment for PoC / Dedicated
- No minimum Dedicated commit required for a trial PoC. We can run the PoC on a small reserved pool or hosted instances. If you'd like Dedicated for predictable throughput during PoC, we can include a 30-day reserved option in the SOW, but it's optional.

Next steps / timeline
1) Priya / procurement to review the attached SOW; we can accept redlines on standard contracting items (IPs, liability cap, and data protection).
2) If procurement signs the SOW, schedule a kickoff (we have availability Tues or Wed next week).
3) Neha will run a 30-45 minute security deep-dive to validate SOC2 artifacts and KMS options.

I'll update the SOW to add an optional 30-day Dedicated reservation line and call out KMS options. Priya — feel free to suggest edits or a time for a procurement call.

Thanks,
Marissa
